newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CONTENT H1 NET PROFIT NLG 6.6 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CONTENT H1 NET PROFIT NLG 6.6 MLN.

text.p: First half 1996
(in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
Net per shr (guilders) 1.22 vs 1.00
Net profit 6.6 vs 5.4
Turnover 180.6 vs 145.2
Operating profit 9.8 vs 7.3
Net interest income 0.9 vs 1.2
Tax 4.1 vs 3.0
NOTE - Content Beheer NV is a temporary employment agency.
Content said the turnover of its core temporary employment
business grew both as a result of favourable economic conditions
and a structural increase in demand for temporary workers.
It said it would continue to expand its network of local
offices to meet the increase in demand.
In the training market Content said its Schoevers
Opleidingen unit (secretarial training) posted a slight rise in
turnover while the market as a whole declined somewhat.
Content said its company training business showed further
strong growth.
